name: Cosmic Pegasus
description: The legendary horse of the stars. Cosmic Pegasus shifts its PC Frame to change modes mid-battle, overwhelming foes with cosmic evolution.

ability.name: Cosmic Mode
ability.description: After using Cosmic Strike, Cosmic Pegasus enters Cosmic Mode for 3 turns. Instantly heals 30 HP, grants +50 Attack power, and generates +2 extra Stamina during Attack or Defense phases for the duration.

special_move.name: Cosmic Strike
special_move.description: Pegasus takes to the skies, descending from orbit in a blazing streak of starlight!
flavour_texts: 💫 **COSMIC STRIKE** — Pegasus rides the galaxy and crashes into the stadium!
